statement: For either signed complete inverse coefficient operator, a bounded unit-supported periodic subsolution h at nonnegative rate q and ternary level r gives C_(d+1)(a)>=(3/2^(2*3^r))*h(b)*q^d for every coordinate b, depth d and positive odd unit root a. A positive h(b) therefore gives a positive constant uniform in a,d. Any sequence of nonzero such tables with nonnegative rates tending to one implies: for every 0<t<1 there exists c_t>0 such that C_(d+1)(a)>=c_t*t^d at every depth and positive odd unit root. In particular this necessity holds for greatest capped tables positive at one fixed root. No root-to-deficit estimate is needed for this implication. Neither the family, the global floor nor coefficient divergence is proved. Kernel-checked; independent review and advisory statement coverage pending.
